attchmntText: Polyplex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding solar power project with Clean Max''.
voiceSummary: Polyplex Corporation Limited has decided not to proceed with its proposal to invest up to Rs. 1,100 Lakh towards an equity stake in Clean Max Neht Private Limited. This decision follows a review by the Board of Directors, which cited a change in economies or savings from the investment as the reason for withdrawal. The proposal was initially intimated on March 25, 2026, for the purchase of solar power for the Company’s plants at Khatima and Bazpur. The Board Meeting commenced at about 1510 Hours IST and concluded at about 1636 Hours IST on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Polyplex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in Company Secretary/Compliance Officer
voiceSummary: Polyplex Corporation Limited announced changes to its Key Managerial Personnel following a Board meeting on November 13, 2026. Mr. Ashok Kumar Gurnani, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, will retire from service effective November 30, 2026, upon completion of his extended employment period. The Board approved the appointment of Ms. Shubha Singh as the new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective December 1, 2026. Ms. Singh is a qualified Company Secretary with ICSI membership number A16735. She holds an MBA from IMT Ghaziabad, an LL.B., and a B.Com. from Delhi University. She also has a CFA and PGDFA from ICFAI and completed an Executive CEO Program at IIM Lucknow. Prior to this role, she served as Company Secretary and Legal Head at JBM Group since June 2024. She is not related to any Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Company.

attchmntText: Polyplex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Polyplex Corporation Limited declared an interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27 at Rs. 12 per share with a face value of Rs. 10. The record date for this dividend is November 20, 2026. Payment will be made within the time prescribed under law, subject to TDS or withholding tax. The board meeting took place on November 13, 2026, starting at 1510 hours IST and concluding at 1636 hours IST.

attchmntText: Polyplex Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Polyplex Corporation Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, following a Board meeting on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 50,516 lakh, with a profit after tax of Rs. 3,154 lakh and basic earnings per share of Rs. 10.04. For the half year, standalone revenue was Rs. 94,469 lakh, with a profit after tax of Rs. 4,402 lakh and basic earnings per share of Rs. 14.02. The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs. 12 per share for the financial year 2026-27, with a record date of November 20, 2026. The company also acquired a 51% stake in TechNova Printrite Products Private Limited, renamed Polyplex DigiPrint Private Limited, for Rs. 7,349 lakh. Limited review reports from auditors are enclosed with the announcement.
